en.hubeali: From him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza who said,

‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said to Abu Baseer, ‘If you fear a matter taking place or a need which you require, so begin with Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and Glorify Him<sup>azwj</sup> and Extol upon Him<sup>azwj</sup> just as He<sup>azwj</sup> is Rightful of it, and send Blessings upon the Prophet<sup>saww</sup> and ask your need, and try to cry and even if it (the teardrop) is like the head of the fly.
The Prophetsaww was saying: ‘The closest of what the servant can be from the Lordazwj Mighty and Majestic is when performing Sajdah and while he is weeping’.
en.sarwar: 10. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Ali ibn abu Hamza who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) has said to abu Basir, ‘If you are afraid of something or need help, then begin with Allah and His glory and praise Him as He deserves. Then ask Allah’s favors for the Holy Prophet and ask for help, tiy to weep even if your tears are of the size of the head of a fly.
Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) would say, ‘a servant (of Allah) in prostration and weeping is in the nearest position to Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy.’”
